_note: Column names, types, descriptions, and key flags of SourceMedium's published relations, read from the SourceMedium demo warehouse and its data dictionary on 2026-10-05. No data. Your warehouse may differ; with live configuration, pnpm schema reads your own. Products and cohort schemas added from the demo warehouse on 2026-10-07.

columns.name: sm_channel
columns.description: Sales channel via hierarchy: (1) exclusion tag 'sm-exclude-order' -> excluded; (2) config sheet overrides; (3) default logic (amazon/tiktok_shop/walmart.com, pos/leap -> retail, wholesale tags -> wholesale, otherwise online_dtc). Note: excluded channel is omitted from Executive Summary and LTV.

columns.name: sm_sub_channel
columns.description: Sub-channel from source/tags with config overrides (e.g., Facebook & Instagram, Google, Amazon FBA/Fulfilled by Merchant).

columns.name: date
columns.description: The date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

columns.name: order_count
columns.description: The number of orders placed by customers.

columns.name: order_gross_revenue
columns.description: The gross revenue for orders, based on order lines. Gross revenue is calculated by multiplying the price of an order's lines by the quantity purchased. Gross revenue excludes revenue from gift card purchases.

columns.name: order_net_revenue
columns.description: The gross order revenue minus order discounts and refunds.

columns.name: order_total_revenue
columns.description: Total order revenue after factoring in shipping revenue, taxes collected, discounts, and refunds.

columns.name: order_discounts
columns.description: The total amount of discounts applied to orders.

columns.name: order_refunds
columns.description: The total amount of refunds applied to orders.

columns.name: order_net_shipping_revenue
columns.description: The gross shipping revenue for orders minus shipping discounts and shipping refunds.

columns.name: order_total_taxes
columns.description: The amount of order and shipping taxes minus order and shipping tax refunds.

columns.name: order_shipping_cost
columns.description: The blended cost to ship products to customers, considering that shipping costs are variable order costs included in cost of goods sold (COGS). This data is set in the Financial Cost - Shipping tab of the SourceMedium financial cost configuration sheet.

columns.name: order_return_cost
columns.description: The blended cost to handle returned products from a customer, considering that the cost of returns is a variable order cost included in cost of goods sold (COGS). This data is entered in the Financial Cost - Shipping tab of the SourceMedium financial cost configuration sheet.

columns.name: order_fulfillment_cost
columns.description: The blended cost to fulfill (pick and pack) orders for customers, considering that fulfillment cost is a variable order cost included in cost of goods sold (COGS). This data is recorded in the Financial Cost - Fulfillment tab of the financial cost configuration sheet.

columns.name: order_merchant_processing_fees
columns.description: The payment processing fees for orders. This data is entered in the Financial Cost - Merchant Processing Fees tab of the SourceMedium financial cost configuration sheet.

columns.name: operating_expenses
columns.description: The cost the business incurs while performing its normal operational activities. This data is entered into the Financial Cost - Operating Expenses tab of the SourceMedium financial cost configuration sheet.

columns.name: order_product_cost
columns.description: The landed cost of orders as defined by the SourceMedium financial cost configuration sheet (or input into Shopify) multiplied by the quantity purchased. The SourceMedium financial cost configuration overrides any costs input into Shopify.

columns.name: product_gross_profit
columns.description: Net order line revenue minus product cost.

columns.name: gross_profit
columns.description: Net order revenue and shipping revenue minus order product cost, order shipping cost, order fulfillment cost, and merchant processing fees.

columns.name: contribution_profit
columns.description: Gross profit minus ad spend.

columns.name: net_profit
columns.description: Gross profit minus ad spend and operating expenses.

columns.name: ad_spend
columns.description: The amount of money spent on ads.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_conversions
columns.description: The number of conversions attributable to ads, as reported by the advertising platform.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_revenue
columns.description: The amount of revenue attributable to the ads, as reported by the advertising platform.

columns.name: ad_clicks
columns.description: The number of times ads were clicked.

columns.name: ad_impressions
columns.description: The number of times ads were shown.

columns.name: website_sessions
columns.description: The number of sessions on the website.

columns.name: new_subscription_count
columns.description: The number of new subscriptions started by customers.

columns.name: cancelled_subscription_count
columns.description: The number of subscriptions voluntarily cancelled by customers.

columns.name: cancelled_passive_subscription_count
columns.description: The number of subscriptions that were terminated without active customer initiation, often due to reasons like the natural expiration of the subscription period.

columns.name: active_subscription_count
columns.description: The number of active subscriptions with a store.

columns.name: new_subscriber_count
columns.description: The number of customers who converted on their first subscription program.

columns.name: cancelled_subscriber_count
columns.description: The number of customers who cancelled their final subscription (they do not have any active subscriptions).

columns.name: active_subscriber_count
columns.description: The number of customers who have at least one active subscription.

columns.name: customer_count
columns.description: The number of unique customers who made a purchase.

columns.name: new_customer_count
columns.description: The number of unique customers who made their first purchase. Special Considerations: Platform coverage varies; tests allow for low coverage thresholds in some cases.

columns.name: repeat_customer_count
columns.description: The number of unique customers who made at least their second purchase.

columns.name: new_customer_order_net_revenue
columns.description: The net order revenue from new customers.

columns.name: repeat_customer_order_net_revenue
columns.description: The net order revenue from repeat customers.

columns.name: new_customer_order_gross_revenue
columns.description: The gross order revenue from new customers.

columns.name: repeat_customer_order_gross_revenue
columns.description: The gross order revenue from repeat customers. Special Considerations: Platform aggregation rules can differ; see tests for permitted thresholds.

columns.name: new_customer_order_count
columns.description: The number of orders from new customers.

columns.name: repeat_customer_order_count
columns.description: The number of orders from repeat customers.

columns.name: order_gross_revenue_after_discounts
columns.description: The gross order revenue minus order discounts.

columns.name: target_order_gross_revenue
columns.description: The gross order revenue target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_order_net_revenue
columns.description: The net order revenue target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_total_order_revenue
columns.description: The total order revenue target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_order_count
columns.description: The order count target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_ad_spend
columns.description: The ad spend target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_website_sessions
columns.description: The website sessions target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_average_order_value
columns.description: The average order value target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_return_on_ad_spend
columns.description: The return on ad spend target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

columns.name: target_order_conversion_rate
columns.description: The order conversion rate target for the store. This data is entered in the Targets tab of the SourceMedium configuration sheet.

rpt_executive_summary_daily.description: Daily KPI aggregation for executive reporting and dashboards (revenue, ROAS, profit, targets). Grain: One row per (smcid, sm_channel, sm_sub_channel, date). Date field: date. Critical filters: sm_channel for channel-specific KPIs; date for time windows. Key joins: none; drill down to obt_orders using (date, sm_channel) filters.

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: The advertising source system used to deliver the ad.

columns.name: sm_channel
columns.description: The sales channel associated with the ad.

columns.name: sub_channel
columns.description: Sub-channel classification for the ad, typically derived from campaign naming or ad platform specifics. Provides additional granularity beyond sm_channel for channel-specific analysis (e.g., Affiliate, Brand, Retargeting).

columns.name: date
columns.description: The date when the ad was delivered.

columns.name: ad_spend
columns.description: The amount of money spent on the ad.

columns.name: ad_clicks
columns.description: The number of times the ad was clicked.

columns.name: ad_inline_link_clicks
columns.description: The number of clicks on links within the ad that led users to advertiser-specified destinations. Subset of total ad_clicks; excludes non-link engagement clicks (e.g., likes, comments).

columns.name: ad_impressions
columns.description: The number of times the ad was shown.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_conversions
columns.description: The number of conversions attributable to the ad, as reported by the advertising platform.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_revenue
columns.description: The amount of revenue attributable to the ad, as reported by the advertising platform.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_revenue_windows
columns.description: Platform-reported revenue by attribution window. The struct is populated only when the upstream adapter supplies window detail and is null otherwise. Meta supplies populated structs; unsupported fields within those structs are zero.

columns.name: ad_platform_reported_conversion_windows
columns.description: Platform-reported conversions by attribution window. The struct is populated only when the upstream adapter supplies window detail and is null otherwise. Meta supplies populated structs; unsupported fields within those structs are zero.

columns.name: ad_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the ad.

columns.name: ad_name
columns.description: The name of the ad.

columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the ad group that contains the ad. Used to group related ads within a campaign for organizational and reporting purposes.

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.description: The name of the ad group that contains the ad. Provides human-readable identification for ad set organization within campaigns.

columns.name: ad_account_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the ad account that is associated with the ad.

columns.name: ad_account_name
columns.description: The name of the ad account that is associated with the ad.

columns.name: ad_campaign_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the campaign that is associated with the ad.

columns.name: ad_campaign_name
columns.description: The name of the campaign that is associated with the ad.

columns.name: ad_campaign_type
columns.description: The type of campaign that is associated with the ad, such as reach, discovery, search, display, or video (this campaign type will vary by advertising platform).

columns.name: ad_campaign_tactic
columns.description: The tactic of the campaign derived from campaign naming conventions. Possible values are "Prospecting", "Retargeting", and "Brand". Default is "Prospecting".

columns.name: ad_platform_campaign_objective
columns.description: The objective of the campaign that is associated with the ad, such as "maximize conversion" or "target impression share" (the campaign objective will vary by advertising platform).

columns.name: ad_creative_id
columns.description: The unique identifier for the ad creative that is associated with the ad.

columns.name: ad_creative_title
columns.description: The title of the ad creative used for the ad.

columns.name: ad_creative_body
columns.description: The body copy of the ad creative used for the ad.

columns.name: ad_creative_image_url
columns.description: The URL of the image used in the ad creative.

columns.name: ad_creative_thumbnail_url
columns.description: The URL of the thumbnail image used in the ad creative.

columns.name: ad_creative_call_to_action_type
columns.description: The type of call-to-action used in the ad creative, such as "order now" or "sign up" (the call to action type will vary by advertising platform).

columns.name: ad_creative_link_params
columns.description: The URL parameters used in the ad creative link.

columns.name: ad_creative_website_url
columns.description: The click-through Website URL configured on the ad creative (the Ads Manager "Destination" value). Meta Ads only today; sourced from asset_feed_spec.link_urls for Advantage+/flexible-format creatives and from the object_story_spec link fields for classic creatives. This is the destination as configured: query strings are kept and url_tags templating is not applied (that lives in ad_creative_link_p

columns.name: ad_creative_instagram_url
columns.description: The URL of the ad creative as it appears on Instagram.

columns.name: ad_creative_facebook_url
columns.description: The URL of the ad creative as it appears on Facebook.

rpt_ad_performance_daily.description: Daily platform-native advertising performance rows. Grain is not unique at the visible keys: hidden sub-ad breakdowns can produce multiple rows for (smcid, source_system, sm_channel, date, ad_id), and ad_id may be NULL. Aggregate metrics before reporting; do not deduplicate or treat (source_system, ad_id) as unique. Date field: date. Critical filters: sm_channel and source_system. Blend with rpt_executive_summary_daily by date and sm_channel.

columns.name: sm_order_key
columns.description: Stable SourceMedium order key. Unique per order. Key joins: `obt_order_lines` (1:many via `sm_order_key`); `dim_customers` (many:1 via `sm_customer_key`). Platform caveat: TikTok Shop coverage may be limited. Primary key (grain: one row per sm_order_key). Join to obt_order_lines via sm_order_key (1:many), obt_customers via sm_customer_key (many:1), dim_orders via sm_order_key (1:1).

columns.name: sm_customer_key
columns.description: Stable SourceMedium customer key. Unique per customer. Key joins: `dim_customers` (1:1); `dim_orders`/`obt_orders` (1:many). Platform caveat: TikTok Shop coverage may be limited. Foreign key to obt_customers (many:1 - multiple orders per customer).

columns.name: source_system
columns.description: Originating platform for the record (e.g., Shopify, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Chargebee). Used for platform‑specific behavior and coverage.

columns.name: order_id
columns.description: Platform order identifier. Not globally unique across stores; pair with `smcid` and `source_system` when needed for scoping.

columns.name: is_pending
columns.description: True for Amazon or Medusa orders with no settled order-line rows. This can represent ingestion lag, terminal itemless orders, or source anomalies; it does not indicate whether an order with at least one settled line is otherwise complete.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.description: The ID of the customer who placed the order.

columns.name: order_name
columns.description: Platform-rendered name (human‑readable or platform‑specific). Not a stable join key.

columns.name: order_number
columns.description: Shop-scoped sequence number assigned by the platform. Not globally unique; pair with `smcid` for scoping.

columns.name: order_checkout_id
columns.description: The ID of the checkout that the order is associated with.

columns.name: order_currency_code
columns.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code used to price and settle the order (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Multi-currency brands should normalize for FX when comparing revenue across currencies.

columns.name: order_original_currency_code
columns.description: Original order currency resolved by the currency conversion runtime. For enabled Shopify stores, this prefers the row-level source currency; otherwise it falls back to order_currency_code.

columns.name: order_converted_currency_code
columns.description: Target reporting currency resolved by the currency conversion runtime. For stores without active conversion settings, this falls back to the original order currency.

columns.name: order_currency_conversion_currency_code
columns.description: Currency code that should describe order-level money fields after conversion is applied. This is the converted currency for converted or passthrough rows, and the original currency for unresolved rows.

columns.name: order_currency_conversion_effective_date
columns.description: Date used to choose the daily FX rate for order currency conversion. Defaults to the order processed date when no active conversion mapping exists.

columns.name: order_currency_conversion_rate_applied
columns.description: Multiplicative rate used to convert order-level money from original currency into converted currency. A value of 1 indicates passthrough, disabled conversion, or unresolved conversion.

columns.name: order_currency_conversion_status
columns.description: Runtime status explaining whether the order was converted, passed through, not enabled, or blocked by missing configuration, missing FX coverage, or a source excluded from the current runtime scope.

columns.name: order_currency_mismatch_flag
columns.description: True when a row-level source currency is available and conflicts with the configured mapping currency. This is diagnostic only; row-level source currency still wins where available.

columns.name: currency_conversion_settings_version
columns.description: Published store-level currency conversion settings version used for the order. Uses __NOT_ENABLED__ when the store does not have active conversion settings.

columns.name: currency_conversion_mapping_id
columns.description: Source/account mapping identifier used to resolve the original and converted currency. Uses __NO_MAPPING__ when no mapping applies.

columns.name: currency_conversion_mapping_source
columns.description: Source of the mapping used for this order, such as operator override or dynamically generated mapping. Uses __NO_MAPPING__ when no mapping applies.

columns.name: currency_conversion_resolution_method
columns.description: Method used to resolve original currency for this order, such as record currency or operator override. Uses __NO_MAPPING__ when no mapping applies.

columns.name: currency_conversion_mapping_from_currency
columns.description: Configured original currency from the mapping that applied to this order. Uses __NO_MAPPING__ when no mapping applies.

columns.name: currency_conversion_mapping_to_currency
columns.description: Configured target currency from the mapping that applied to this order. Uses __NO_MAPPING__ when no mapping applies.

columns.name: order_created_at
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the order was created.

columns.name: order_created_at_local_datetime
columns.description: Order created timestamp converted to reporting timezone (from order_created_at UTC).

columns.name: order_updated_at
columns.description: UTC timestamp from source system when the order was last updated.

columns.name: order_updated_at_local_datetime
columns.description: Order last updated timestamp converted to reporting timezone (from order_updated_at UTC).

columns.name: order_processed_at
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the order was processed.

columns.name: order_processed_at_local_datetime
columns.description: Order processed timestamp converted to reporting timezone (from order_processed_at UTC). Primary date field for order analytics and time-based filtering.

columns.name: order_cancelled_at
columns.description: UTC timestamp when the order was cancelled. Null if order has not been cancelled.

columns.name: order_cancelled_at_local_datetime
columns.description: Order cancelled timestamp converted to reporting timezone (from order_cancelled_at UTC). Null if order has not been cancelled.

columns.name: order_cancellation_reason
columns.description: The reason an order was cancelled (sourced from the platform, e.g. Shopify's cancel_reason). A reason of 'fraud' or 'declined' marks the order as not sm-valid (is_order_sm_valid = false) regardless of payment status.

columns.name: sm_order_sales_channel
columns.description: Raw sales channel from Shopify specifically (e.g., 'TikTok Shop', 'Instagram Shop'). Some values are used as input dimension for sm_channel mapping. See sm_channel for final classification. Others are used for analysis.

columns.name: sm_order_landing_page
columns.description: Path of the page where the buyer landed when they entered the shop (`/products/x`). Never a scheme+host URL. Checkout, invoice and cart URLs collapse to `/checkouts`, `/invoices` and `/cart`.

columns.name: sm_order_referrer_domain
columns.description: Domain derived from order_referring_site.

columns.name: order_index
columns.description: Ordered index identifying the sequential position of an order among the orders present in SourceMedium's data for a customer (1..N, oldest = 1). Counts only ingested orders and is fully self-contained; for tenants with incomplete ingested history (see int_shopify__incomplete_history_flags) this can understate the customer's true lifetime position.

columns.name: order_index_reversed
columns.description: Ordered index identifying the sequential position of an order in a customer's order history, in reverse order (newest = 1). Ranks the orders present in SourceMedium's data.

columns.name: order_tags_csv
columns.description: Comma-separated list of tags that the shop owner has attached to the order. Use for simple filtering; beware that individual tag values may contain commas.

columns.name: order_vendors_csv
columns.description: Comma-separated list of product vendors in the order, aggregated from line items. Vendor names may vary by platform; use for vendor mix analysis at order level.

columns.name: order_sequence
columns.description: Customer lifecycle classification: 'First Order' for new customers, 'Repeat Order' for returning customers. Includes all orders (valid + invalid). Use for cohort analysis and retention reporting. See valid_order_index for valid-only ordering.

columns.name: order_session_user_agent
columns.description: Raw user agent string. Used to derive customer_device_type and order_session_browser_type.

columns.name: customer_device_type
columns.description: Device type derived from user agent (e.g., mobile, desktop, tablet). Coverage depends on website tracking; limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: order_session_browser_type
columns.description: Browser type derived from user agent (e.g., chrome, safari, firefox). Coverage depends on website tracking; limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: order_payment_status
columns.description: Financial status of the order (e.g., paid, partially_paid, partially_refunded, authorized, pending, refunded, voided, draft). Platform‑defined.

columns.name: order_processing_method
columns.description: Method used to process the order (e.g., 'manual', 'direct', 'offsite'). Platform-defined strings; some methods may only appear for specific integrations.

columns.name: primary_order_payment_gateway
columns.description: The technology or service that securely transmitted payment information between the customer, the business, and the payment processor.

columns.name: order_shipping_country_code
columns.description: The two-letter code (ISO 3166-1 format) for the country of the shipping address.

columns.name: order_shipping_country
columns.description: The country of the shipping address.

columns.name: order_shipping_city
columns.description: The city, town, or village of the shipping address.

columns.name: order_shipping_zip_code
columns.description: Postal/ZIP code from the shipping address (alphanumeric, varies by country). Use with country and state to avoid ambiguity; not geo-normalized.

columns.name: order_customer_street_address
columns.description: Customer's billing street address associated with the order. May differ from shipping address; use for billing analysis and fraud detection.

columns.name: order_shipping_state
columns.description: Province/state of the shipping address; format varies by country and platform.

columns.name: order_cart_quantity
columns.description: The quantity of items that were originally purchased in an order.

columns.name: is_price_tax_inclusive
columns.description: Whether taxes are included in the order subtotal.

columns.name: sm_default_channel
columns.description: Default channel before overrides, from source name and tags: amazon/tiktok_shop/walmart.com; pos/leap -> retail; wholesale tags -> wholesale; otherwise online_dtc. See sm_channel for final channel.

columns.name: sm_channel
columns.description: Sales channel via hierarchy: (1) exclusion tag 'sm-exclude-order' -> excluded; (2) config sheet overrides; (3) default logic (amazon/tiktok_shop/walmart.com, pos/leap -> retail, wholesale tags -> wholesale, otherwise online_dtc). Note: excluded channel is omitted from Executive Summary and LTV.

columns.name: sm_sub_channel
columns.description: Sub-channel from source/tags with config overrides (e.g., Facebook & Instagram, Google, Amazon FBA/Fulfilled by Merchant).

columns.name: sm_order_type
columns.description: Order classification (subscription vs one-time) derived from order attributes, tags, or subscription platforms (Shopify Subscription Contract, ReCharge, Skio, Loop, Stay AI).

columns.name: subscription_order_index
columns.description: Ordered index identifying the sequential position of a subscription order in a customer's subscription order history.

columns.name: subscription_order_sequence
columns.description: Subscription lifecycle classification: 'First Subscription Order' for initial subscription purchase, 'Repeat Subscription Order' for renewals. Based on subscription order index when available, otherwise inferred from order tags. Use for subscription cohort analysis.

columns.name: sm_utm_source
columns.description: Last-click UTM source from attribution waterfall (Shopify visits/landing/order attributes → website events → GA/GA4 → referrer). For Shopify, order-level attribution includes allowlisted order `customAttributes` and legacy `note_attributes`, including parsing aggregate `utmParams`/`GE_utmParams`; if explicit `utm_source` is missing, `sm_utm_source` may be inferred from click IDs (e.g., `gclid` → g

columns.name: sm_utm_medium
columns.description: Last-click UTM medium from attribution waterfall (Shopify visits/landing/order attributes → website events → GA/GA4 → referrer). Native on Shopify/Chargebee; enriched via website tracking (Elevar, Blotout, Snowplow). Limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: sm_utm_campaign
columns.description: Last-click UTM campaign from attribution waterfall (Shopify visits/landing/order attributes → website events → GA/GA4 → referrer). Native on Shopify/Chargebee; enriched via website tracking (Elevar, Blotout, Snowplow). Limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: sm_utm_content
columns.description: Last-click UTM content from attribution waterfall (Shopify visits/landing/order attributes → website events → GA/GA4 → referrer). Native on Shopify/Chargebee; enriched via website tracking (Elevar, Blotout, Snowplow). Limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: sm_utm_term
columns.description: Last-click UTM term from attribution waterfall (Shopify visits/landing/order attributes → website events → GA/GA4 → referrer). Native on Shopify/Chargebee; enriched via website tracking (Elevar, Blotout, Snowplow). Limited for marketplaces.

columns.name: sm_utm_id
columns.description: SourceMedium-generated unique identifier for UTM parameter combinations on this order. Used to link orders to specific marketing campaigns via UTM tracking.

columns.name: sm_gclid
columns.description: Google Click Identifier (GCLID) from Google Ads campaigns, used to track paid search conversions. Present when order originated from Google Ads click-through.

columns.name: sm_fbclid
columns.description: Facebook Click Identifier (FBCLID) from Meta/Facebook ad campaigns, used to track social media conversions. Present when order originated from Facebook/Instagram ad click-through.

columns.name: sm_ttclid
columns.description: TikTok Click Identifier (TTCLID) captured from the selected pre-purchase event or order referring URL. The original case-sensitive token is preserved for downstream click-log joins.

columns.name: sm_utm_source_medium
columns.description: Concatenation of source / medium (e.g., 'google / cpc'). Shows '(none) / (none)' when null.

columns.name: customer_email_hashed
columns.description: A hashed version of the customer's email address.

columns.name: customer_tags_csv
columns.description: Comma-separated customer tags at time of order; string version of customer_tags_array. Prefer array field for robust matching; CSV can include commas in tag values.

columns.name: order_refund_quantity
columns.description: The quantity of order lines originally purchased in an order that were refunded.

columns.name: order_original_gross_revenue
columns.description: Gross order revenue expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_gross_revenue
columns.description: Gross order revenue converted using order_currency_conversion_rate_applied.

columns.name: order_original_discounts
columns.description: Order discounts expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_discounts
columns.description: Order discounts converted using order_currency_conversion_rate_applied.

columns.name: order_original_refunds
columns.description: Order refunds expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_refunds
columns.description: Order refunds converted using order_currency_conversion_rate_applied.

columns.name: order_original_net_revenue
columns.description: Net order revenue expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_net_revenue
columns.description: Net order revenue converted using order_currency_conversion_rate_applied.

columns.name: order_original_gross_taxes
columns.description: Gross non-shipping order taxes expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_gross_taxes
columns.description: Gross non-shipping order taxes converted using the applied FX rate.

columns.name: order_original_tax_refunds
columns.description: Non-shipping tax refunds expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_tax_refunds
columns.description: Non-shipping tax refunds converted using the applied FX rate.

columns.name: order_original_net_taxes
columns.description: Net non-shipping order taxes expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_net_taxes
columns.description: Net non-shipping order taxes converted using the applied FX rate.

columns.name: order_original_gross_shipping
columns.description: Gross shipping revenue expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_gross_shipping
columns.description: Gross shipping revenue converted using the applied FX rate.

columns.name: order_original_shipping_discounts
columns.description: Shipping discounts expressed in the original order currency.

columns.name: order_converted_shipping_discounts
columns.description: Shipping discounts converted using the applied FX rate.

columns.name: order_original_shipping_refunds
columns.description: Shipping refunds expressed in the original order currency.

rpt_cohort_ltv_by_first_valid_purchase_a.description: Cohort LTV analysis by first valid purchase attributes (channel, campaign, source) with no product filters. Grain: One row per cohort_filter_name_filter_value_month_id. Date field: cohort_month. Critical filters: acquisition_order_filter_dimension for cohort grouping; cohort_month for time selection.
